The following events occurred in '''1032 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Volfe Karkko]] is imprisoned in a [[Stasis field/Legends|stasis field]] on [[Kiffex/Legends|Kiffex]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="Darkness 3" />
*[[Kerra Holt]] passes her Jedi Trials and becomes a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]].<ref name="KE 0">[[Knight Errant 0|''Knight Errant'' 0]]</ref>
*[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vannar Treece]]'s [[Operation Influx]] occurs in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]].<ref name="KE:Influx">{{SWArchive|url=vault/books/knighterrant_influx/index.html|text=''Star Wars: Knight Errant: Influx''|int=Star Wars: Knight Errant: Influx}}</ref>
*The [[Chelloan affair]] ends in the [[Destruction of Chelloa|destruction]] of the planet's surface.<ref name="SWKE5">[[Knight Errant 5|''Knight Errant'' 5]]</ref>
*[[Bactranate]] falls to the [[Daimanate]] and the [[Odionate]].<ref name="Knight Errant" />
*[[Dyarchy]] falls to the [[Arkadianate]].<ref name="Knight Errant" />
*Three-way [[Aquilaris campaign]] between the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] lord [[Zodoh]], [[Daimanate]], and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] ends in the [[Great Aquilaris Deluge]] on [[Aquilaris Minor]].<ref name="SWKE9">[[Knight Errant: Deluge 4|''Knight Errant: Deluge'' 4]]</ref>
*[[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Odion]] restarts [[Project Pandemonium]] to find the [[Helm of Ieldis]].<ref name="SWKE11">[[Knight Errant: Escape 1|''Knight Errant: Escape'' 1]]</ref>
*The Odionate invades [[Sarrassia/Legends|Sarrassia]].<ref name="SWKE12">[[Knight Errant: Escape 2|''Knight Errant: Escape'' 2]]</ref>
*Odion and Lord [[Malakite]] fight over control of [[Skarpos]], ending with Odion obtaining the Helm.<ref name="SWKE14">[[Knight Errant: Escape 4|''Knight Errant: Escape'' 4]]</ref>
*The Odionate collapses during the [[Battle of Vanahame]], with the death of Odion and the destruction of the Helm.<ref name="SWKE15">[[Knight Errant: Escape 5|''Knight Errant: Escape'' 5]]</ref>
*On [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] several [[Fungus/Legends|fungi]] germinates.<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I Jedi Power Battles: Prima's Official Strategy Guide">[[Star Wars: Episode I Jedi Power Battles: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Jedi Power Battles'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>
